children.title: The inferential path-dependence of preference formation models under misspecification constrains the stability…

detail.statement: The inferential path-dependence of preference formation models under misspecification constrains the stability of autonomous agents, supported by general preference oracle frameworks and recurrence-based convex optimization bounds.
detail.reason: Reviewed under newly available experimental and recurrence-based analysis evidence roots, confirming path-dependent properties and optimization bounds.
